evaluation.goal: Return every consecutive 3-character substring that is a palindrome, in original order; overlapping windows count.
Scan the string from left to right; for each decimal digit append the cumulative sum of all digits seen so far as a string. Ignore nondigits.

For a string containing only '(' and ')', return the 1-based end indices (as strings) of prefixes whose parentheses are balanced and never went negative. Ignore prefixes after the first unmatched ')'.
